name: bell-button
title: Bell button
description: A quiet ghost bell for app headers that wakes up when something arrives: it tips, rings back and settles while the count pops in, or shows a dot when there is no number to read. A click clears the badge until the next arrival and can open your own panel under it, kept on screen, with focus moved in and handed back on Escape.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>, MIT; free component, unchanged
